title: Photovoltaic Penetration, Balancing Volatility and Market Price Cannibalization

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Between 2018 and 2024 Hungary saw a very fast expansion of solar power, with installed capacity exceeding 6,000 MW by 2024. On sunny summer middays solar generation can cover a large part of national demand, which can push wholesale prices below zero (*negatív áramárak*) and puts strain on the grid.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Purpose is often stated with a verbal noun + *-ra/-re* (you know the case from A2 Unit 6): `Az árkannibalizáció mérséklésére sokan akkumulátoros energiatárolók telepítését javasolják az új naperőművek mellé`.
